records.name: Comoros
records.assessment: Three named island ADM1 source shapes compose one Comoros location and occur under one province.
records.uncertainty_and_followup: Current scope separates Mayotte as its own location; this statement concerns mapped physical inputs and source role, not national or historical territorial claims. Verify low island/coastline completeness in the engineering regional integration.

records.name: Madagascar
records.assessment: 119 pinned scoped districts join one-to-one by name to OCHA 2018 ADM2, while complete OCHA COD-AB reviewed 2026 lists 120 ADM2 and 24 ADM1. The old issue scope omits Antanimora Atsimo as an independent administrative unit; its new COD-AB footprint is 99.534% inside current Ambovombe-Androy.
records.uncertainty_and_followup: Current 22 region parent partition differs from 24-region COD-AB names and 15 matched current district shapes differ by >5% from OCHA COD-AB 2018 geometry. Requires bounded integrated source-history/crosswalk follow-up; no source-geography edit here.

records.name: Mauritius
records.assessment: Twelve geoBoundaries ADM1 records are an explicit mixed role collection: nine Mauritius Island districts, Rodrigues, Agalega and St Brandon; there is also a separate disjoint Natural Earth Agaléga record. 2022 Mauritius census Table G1 and Rodrigues Appendix IV establish nine district/VCA and six Rodrigues local regions; Agalega counted 330 residents and St Brandon has no permanent residents.
records.uncertainty_and_followup: Obtain an island-by-island official map/crosswalk for two Agaléga footprints, St Brandon reef/physical land and other outer-island component completeness; ownership and population are not physical land proof.

records.name: Mayotte
records.assessment: Natural Earth overseas-department feature has one scoped location with exact source/current reproduction.
records.uncertainty_and_followup: Physical feature identity is supported; current high-resolution coastline/omitted-islet completeness not certified by Natural Earth 10m.

records.name: Mozambique Channel Islands
records.assessment: One scoped Iles Éparses source location has seven current components and exact Natural Earth 10m source reproduction; it is the Indian Ocean sub-scope and Antarctica is excluded.
records.uncertainty_and_followup: Need an official feature-island inventory suitable for omitted small land/reef checks; do not interpret the administrative ownership record as physical completeness.

records.name: Réunion
records.assessment: Natural Earth overseas-department feature has one scoped location with exact source/current reproduction.
records.uncertainty_and_followup: Natural Earth 10m is not a legal cadastral or completeness certificate for tiny offshore landforms.

records.name: Rodrigues
records.assessment: The Rodrigues source location is one inhabited island group; Mauritius 2022 Census Table G1 identifies six local regions and Appendix IV enumerates their locality lists.
records.uncertainty_and_followup: Administrative locality listing does not itself establish every small offshore islet or boundary line.

records.name: Seychelles
records.assessment: Eight source ADM2 “Regions” crosswalk one-to-one to the Seychelles NBS 2019 statistical region list (8 regions, 27 ADM3 districts).
records.uncertainty_and_followup: Four current province labels differ from NBS-provenance region labels; Other Islands source/current part count is 1057/7. Need current official region-to-island and all-island inventory, especially outer-island completeness; source reference is older than current review date.

method: Audited all eight assigned area scopes and every owned location member; partial scopes are described only for the owned member subset. Antarctica excluded; shared hierarchy/footprints unedited.
